about: Hi there! I'm James Krause and I currently work at AspenTech as Software Developer! I was born and raised in Shakopee, Minnesota and currently live in Eden Prairie. I graduated from Minnesota State University, Mankato in 2022 with a B.S. in Computer Information Technology.

You can find me doing quite a few things when I'm not at work. When I was 5, I started bowling in a league, and continued to bowl on a league until I went to college. At the age of 10, I began playing electric guitar and I later expanded into acoustic and bass guitar. In 2022 as an early Christmas gift to myself, I bought my first digital camera, the Sony A6400 and began my photography journey. My main focus started with cars, but I started to branch out into portraits, landscapes, and even wedding photos!

In my senior year of high school, I built my first gaming PC with money I saved up over the year and that is where I discovered my love for computers and how much I enjoy building them. Since that time, I've built quite a few computers for friends and family, as well as a home server to host docker containers, which you can find in my projects section. It also serves as a Plex Server and a backup for my pictures and videos. Lastly, I have a Raspberry Pi 4 that runs PiHole to block ads across my network, as well as serve as a custom DNS server.

During college, I started seeing YouTube videos on 3D printing. After some research and time to save up, I purchased an Ender 3 V2. In time, I upgraded to a Bambu Lab X1C because it offers a faster, better, and more reliable printing experience. Whether it’s functional designs like custom phone stands, an LED-lit TRON sign, or an Iron Man helmet, I love the creative freedom it offers. I design my own models as well as modify existing ones, and there’s something incredibly satisfying about turning an idea in my head into something tangible I can hold, in just a matter of hours.
